description: Symbols nothing references: no resolved occurrence and no graph edge points at them, after excluding entry points, route handlers, and engine/framework lifecycle callbacks. Candidates with unresolved same-name usages elsewhere are hedged as "possibly dead" — dynamic dispatch and reflection are invisible to a structural index, as are dependency injection, string-keyed lookups and consumers outside the workspace — treat this as a review list, not a delete list, and verify before deleting. A second section lists exported symbols only ever used inside their own file.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

include_exports.description: also list exported symbols with internal-only references

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

path_prefix.description: restrict to files under this root-relative path

name: find_dead_code
title: Find dead code
